lines.zh: 我张着嘴游，一路筛水。
lines.en: I swim with my mouth open, straining the water.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，浮游的东西跑不掉。
lines.en: I swim slowly; the drifting things cannot escape.

lines.zh: 深海的暗里，我几乎不转身。
lines.en: In the dark of the deep, I hardly ever turn.

lines.zh: 我的嘴太宽，游起来像一张网。
lines.en: My mouth is so wide I swim like a net.

lines.zh: 我从暗处上升，只到微光那一层。
lines.en: I rise from the dark only to the dim-lit layer.

lines.zh: 身体软，转弯时要多用一点力。
lines.en: My body is soft; turning takes a little more effort.

lines.zh: 我顺着水里的碎屑走，那里有吃的。
lines.en: I follow the drifting debris; there is food in it.

lines.zh: 磷虾群在动，我就跟着动。
lines.en: The krill swarm shifts, and I shift with it.

lines.zh: 我的下颚有一道白，能在暗里反光。
lines.en: A white band on my jaw catches light in the dark.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴穿过水母群，它们不刺我。
lines.en: I pass through jellyfish with my mouth open; they do not sting.

lines.zh: 我一天要滤几吨水。
lines.en: I strain several tons of water a day.

lines.zh: 我避开有浪的地方，那里水太乱。
lines.en: I avoid rough water; it is too churned there.

lines.zh: 我不追任何东西，我只收集。
lines.en: I chase nothing; I only collect.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍摆一次，能滑很久。
lines.en: One beat of my tail carries me a long way.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地翻过身，露出发白的下颚。
lines.en: I roll slowly, showing my pale lower jaw.

lines.zh: 碎屑一沉，我就跟着往下走。
lines.en: When the drifting scraps sink, I follow them down.

lines.zh: 我几乎不摆尾，水自己推着我。
lines.en: I barely move my tail; the water carries me.

lines.zh: 一大片磷虾在前面，我把嘴张得更大。
lines.en: A broad patch of krill lies ahead, and I open wider.

lines.zh: 我悬着，嘴还张着，水慢慢过。
lines.en: I hang there, mouth open, water passing slowly.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，浮游生物自己会来。
lines.en: I barely move; the plankton come to me.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，多得像砂纸。
lines.en: My teeth are tiny, countless as sandpaper.

lines.zh: 我一生被人看见的次数不多。
lines.en: I have been seen only a few times in my life.

lines.zh: 嘴里那点白光，是我唯一亮的部位。
lines.en: The pale glow in my mouth is my only bright part.

lines.zh: 我慢慢闭嘴，把水挤出去。
lines.en: I close my mouth slowly and press the water out.

lines.zh: 深海的冷我习惯了，像穿一件湿衣。
lines.en: I am used to the deep cold, like a wet coat.

lines.zh: 我的肝很大，能让我浮着。
lines.en: My liver is huge; it keeps me buoyant.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼绕着我，我不吃它们。
lines.en: Small fish circle me; I do not eat them.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，让水流得慢一些。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let the current slow.

lines.zh: 海底的泥很软，我落不下去。
lines.en: The seabed mud is soft; I cannot settle on it.

lines.zh: 我闻到远处有一层浮游生物。
lines.en: I smell a layer of plankton somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 深海里没有声音，只有水。
lines.en: There is no sound in the deep, only water.

lines.zh: 我抬起上颚，让鳃缓一缓。
lines.en: I lift my upper jaw and let my gills rest.

lines.zh: 你的灯照过来，我先看见了光。
lines.en: Your lamp sweeps over; I see the light first.

lines.zh: 我从暗里浮上来，嘴还张着。
lines.en: I rise from the dark, my mouth still open.

lines.zh: 你一定觉得我很可怕，其实不是。
lines.en: You must find me frightening; I am not.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游，没打算咬。
lines.en: I circle you without any intention to bite.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，看不清你的脸。
lines.en: My eyes are small; I cannot make out your face.

lines.zh: 你后退，我就停住了。
lines.en: You pull back, and I stop.

lines.zh: 你把灯调暗，我的白颚更亮了。
lines.en: You dim the lamp, and my pale jaw glows more.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，你吓得屏住了气。
lines.en: I open my mouth and you hold your breath.

lines.zh: 我在看你身后的水，那里更浑。
lines.en: I am looking past you, where the water is murkier.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转开，给你让出一条路。
lines.en: I turn away slowly and leave you a path.

lines.zh: 我的皮很软，一划就开。
lines.en: My hide is soft; it opens at a scratch.

lines.zh: 疼得我合上了嘴，水全挤出来。
lines.en: Pain snaps my mouth shut and squeezes the water out.

lines.zh: 我身上没有硬的地方可以挡。
lines.en: I have no hard part to shield myself with.

lines.zh: 这一下让我沉了很深。
lines.en: The blow sends me sinking deep.

lines.zh: 我的血在暗里散开，很淡。
lines.en: My blood spreads in the dark, faintly.

lines.zh: 我本该躲开的，可我太慢了。
lines.en: I should have dodged, but I am too slow.

lines.zh: 我摆尾想跑，身体却不听。
lines.en: I try to flee, but my body will not obey.

lines.zh: 伤口很浅，可我一直觉得冷。
lines.en: The wound is shallow, yet I keep feeling cold.

lines.zh: 我不反击，我只会沉下去。
lines.en: I do not strike back; I only sink away.

lines.zh: 你的刀划到了我的鳃，很危险。
lines.en: Your blade caught my gills; that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 你手里没有浮游生物，我不会靠近。
lines.en: You hold no plankton; I will not come closer.

lines.zh: 你把水搅起一层碎屑，我来了。
lines.en: You stir up a layer of debris; I come.

lines.zh: 肉块太大，我咽不下去。
lines.en: The meat is too big for me to swallow.

lines.zh: 我只对细小的东西有胃口。
lines.en: I only have an appetite for tiny things.

lines.zh: 你撒下的粉末在水里散开，正好。
lines.en: The powder you scatter spreads just right.

lines.zh: 磷虾的味道很淡，可我知道。
lines.en: The krill's scent is faint, but I know it.

lines.zh: 我绕过去，是想再滤一遍水。
lines.en: I circle back to strain the water once more.

lines.zh: 你举着什么，我看不清，我不在意。
lines.en: You hold something up; I cannot see it, and do not care.

lines.zh: 食物太大会卡住我的鳃。
lines.en: Food too large would clog my gills.

lines.zh: 我张嘴对着那一片，慢慢游过去。
lines.en: I open my mouth at that patch and drift toward it.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的下颚，我吓了一跳。
lines.en: You bump my lower jaw, and I startle.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，撞起来像撞皮革。
lines.en: My body is soft; it feels like hitting leather.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一偏，又一寸寸摆正。
lines.en: The knock slants me; I straighten inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，你差点滑进去。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open; you nearly slip inside.

lines.zh: 我没有力气顶回去。
lines.en: I have no strength to push back.

lines.zh: 你碰我的鳃，我整条停住。
lines.en: You touch my gills, and I stop completely.

lines.zh: 我的皮上留着你的手印。
lines.en: Your handprint stays on my hide.

lines.zh: 我慢慢下沉了一点，躲开你。
lines.en: I sink a little to get clear of you.

lines.zh: 碰一下不疼，只是闷闷的。
lines.en: The bump does not hurt, only dulls.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水里的碎屑全乱了。
lines.en: We collide and the drifting scraps scatter.

lines.zh: 它从暗里浮上来，嘴和我一样宽。
lines.en: It rises from the dark, its mouth as wide as mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排滤水，谁也不挤谁。
lines.en: We strain the water side by side, neither crowding.

lines.zh: 它的白颚在灯下也是亮的。
lines.en: Its pale jaw glows under the light too.

lines.zh: 深海里相遇，比什么都难。
lines.en: Meeting in the deep is harder than anything.

lines.zh: 我们的身体贴在一起，很慢。
lines.en: Our bodies press together, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕它一圈，它就跟着转。
lines.en: I circle it once, and it turns with me.

lines.zh: 幼崽生下来就能自己游。
lines.en: The pups can swim on their own at birth.

lines.zh: 我们不吃东西，只是并排待着。
lines.en: We do not feed; we simply stay side by side.

lines.zh: 等水暖一点，我们就分开。
lines.en: When the water warms a little, we part.

lines.zh: 这片深度只有我们两个。
lines.en: This depth belongs to just the two of us.

lines.zh: 我的牙太小，抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: My teeth are too small to grip anything.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西沉下去，我就跟着下去。
lines.en: Dropped things sink, and I follow them down.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推，它太硬。
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth; it is too hard.

lines.zh: 我不吞金属，鳃会堵。
lines.en: I do not swallow metal; it clogs my gills.

lines.zh: 那些碎屑里混进了铁粒，我吐出来。
lines.en: Iron bits mix into the debris; I spit them out.

lines.zh: 沉船的木屑我能滤，铁不行。
lines.en: I can strain splinters from wrecks, but not iron.

lines.zh: 东西落到海底，太深了，我不去。
lines.en: It lands on the floor, too deep; I do not go.

lines.zh: 我张嘴对着它，还是咽不下。
lines.en: I open my mouth at it and still cannot swallow.

lines.zh: 有块布漂过来，我滤掉了。
lines.en: A scrap of cloth drifts by; I strain it out.

lines.zh: 水桶装得下我，装不下这些东西。
lines.en: A bucket holds me, but not these things.

lines.zh: 我不锁人，我锁的是一片水。
lines.en: I do not lock onto people; I lock onto water.

lines.zh: 前面那层碎屑，就是我的目标。
lines.en: That layer of debris ahead is my target.

lines.zh: 你不在我的名单上，除非你搅起水。
lines.en: You are not on my list, unless you stir the water.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，对着最浑的那一块。
lines.en: I open my mouth at the murkiest patch.

lines.zh: 目标越小，我越喜欢。
lines.en: The smaller the target, the better I like it.

lines.zh: 那群磷虾一散，我就知道方向错了。
lines.en: The krill scatter; I know I chose wrong.

lines.zh: 我把注意力放在水流上，不是你。
lines.en: I give my attention to the current, not to you.

lines.zh: 你要是不动，我根本发现不了你。
lines.en: If you kept still, I would never notice you.

lines.zh: 我选中的是那片发亮的水。
lines.en: What I have chosen is that glimmering water.

lines.zh: 选定之后，我就慢慢游过去。
lines.en: Once chosen, I drift toward it slowly.

lines.zh: 我跟着那层碎屑，游了很久。
lines.en: I have followed that drifting layer a long while.

lines.zh: 水流把它推走，我又绕回来。
lines.en: The current pushes it away; I circle back.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，一路筛过去。
lines.en: I keep my mouth open and strain the whole way.

lines.zh: 我不拐急弯，软身体扛不住。
lines.en: I cannot turn sharply; my soft body will not take it.

lines.zh: 它漂得慢，我比它还慢。
lines.en: It drifts slowly; I drift slower still.

lines.zh: 我绕开礁石，那会刮破我的嘴。
lines.en: I skirt the reef; it would tear my mouth.

lines.zh: 我顺着最暗的水走，那里碎屑多。
lines.en: I follow the darkest water; more debris gathers there.

lines.zh: 你挡在中间，我只好从旁边过。
lines.en: You are in the way; I go around you.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，离猎物最近。
lines.en: I keep near the bottom, closest to my food.

lines.zh: 这一路我都没张嘴咬过东西。
lines.en: All this way I have not closed my mouth on anything.

lines.zh: 我合上嘴，把你半个人含住了。
lines.en: I close my mouth and half of you is inside.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我只是合上了嘴。
lines.en: I do not bite; I merely closed my mouth.

lines.zh: 这一撞没有牙，却也很沉。
lines.en: There are no teeth in this blow, but it is heavy.

lines.zh: 你被我的下颚推得翻了身。
lines.en: My lower jaw shoves you into a roll.

lines.zh: 我的牙磨过你的皮，像砂纸。
lines.en: My teeth scrape your skin like sandpaper.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你甩了出去。
lines.en: I shake my head and throw you clear.

lines.zh: 我根本不知道自己撞到了什么。
lines.en: I have no idea what I just hit.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我嘴里多了块硬东西。
lines.en: After that, something hard is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吞了一口水，把你冲开。
lines.en: I swallow a mouthful of water and wash you away.

lines.zh: 我退开，游得比来时快一点。
lines.en: I withdraw, swimming a little faster than I came.

lines.zh: 我在微光层里成形，水很冷。
lines.en: I take shape in the dim layer; the water is cold.

lines.zh: 深海的暗里，先亮起我的白颚。
lines.en: In the deep dark my pale jaw lights first.

lines.zh: 我从底下升上来，嘴已经张开。
lines.en: I rise from below with my mouth already open.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，声音在水里很闷。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks; the sound is muffled underwater.

lines.zh: 这片海太亮，我不太习惯。
lines.en: This sea is too bright; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 我第一次滤水，滤到了一点碎屑。
lines.en: My first straining yields a little debris.

lines.zh: 我慢慢游开，找更暗的地方。
lines.en: I drift away to find somewhere darker.

lines.zh: 有人在深水里放了我，我记住了。
lines.en: Someone placed me in deep water; I remember.

lines.zh: 从桶里倒出来，我落得很轻。
lines.en: Poured from a bucket, I land very softly.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，开始这一生的第一顿饭。
lines.en: Mouth open, I begin the first meal of my life.

lines.zh: 火在水里也能烧，我的皮缩了。
lines.en: Fire burns even underwater; my hide shrinks.

lines.zh: 我被摔在石上，软身体塌了。
lines.en: Slammed on stone, my soft body collapses.

lines.zh: 海水太多，我的鳃装不下。
lines.en: Too much seawater; my gills cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 冲击过来，我的嘴合不住。
lines.en: The blast hits, and my mouth will not close.

lines.zh: 箭穿进软肉里，很深的。
lines.en: The arrow sinks deep into my soft flesh.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光从鳃里进去，凉得发疼。
lines.en: Strange light enters through my gills, cold and aching.

lines.zh: 水里空了，我滤不到任何东西。
lines.en: The water is empty; I strain nothing at all.

lines.zh: 雷光闪过，我滤食的嘴合上了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and my filter-feeding mouth snaps shut.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的鳃全干了。
lines.en: The void has no water; my gills dry out entirely.
